name: Statistic
summary: A single headline number with a caption, prefix/suffix (text or icon), precision, trend colour and a loading skeleton.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-statistic> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; `label` captions the figure, `value` is the number (`precision` formats it to N decimals with thousands separators), `prefix`/`suffix` frame it as text and `prefix-icon`/`suffix-icon` frame it with a DS icon by name, and `trend` tints the figure success-green or error-red with a matching arrow glyph so the up/down signal is never colour-only. `loading` swaps in a shimmer skeleton. Icons are summoned by name from the DS library via <aha-icon> — never an inline glyph. Zero drift — the same element.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: precision
props.desc: Format value to N decimal places with en-US thousands separators (non-numeric values left verbatim)

props.name: prefix
props.desc: Small text before the value (e.g. a currency mark)

props.name: suffix
props.desc: Small text after the value (e.g. %, unit)

props.name: prefix-icon
props.desc: A DS icon before the value (e.g. system-currency-circle-dollar)

props.name: suffix-icon
props.desc: A DS icon after the value

props.name: trend
props.desc: Tint the value success-green/error-red + a matching trend arrow glyph

props.name: loading
props.desc: Show a shimmer skeleton in place of the figure

whenToUse.when: a single KPI on a dashboard or results screen
a small count attached to another element
a value's share of a whole

opinion.note: Caption names the metric in sentence case — 'Active players', not 'ACTIVE PLAYERS'. Use trend only when up/down carries meaning; the element pairs the tint with a trend arrow glyph so colour is never the sole signal. Reach for prefix-icon/suffix-icon (a currency mark, a %) over a decorative image; set precision for money/rates so the figure reads consistently.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 ships a real Statistic component set (key 6f817785…, 'Display statistic number') plus Components/Trend + Trend Group (the coloured up/down indicator). Element enumerated against that taxonomy: title (label) + big value + precision + prefix/suffix (text or icon) + trend colour with a matching Trend glyph + loading. Trend bound to --aha-color-success / --aha-color-error; value 24/32 SemiBold per antd Statistic. Node-id/screenshot navigation is seat-gated, so the matrix is read from the component-set taxonomy, not a pixel match.
